text.content:
• Fixed tournament bracket race conditions: startTournamentBracket now blocks double-tap re-generation, and both startTournamentBracket/reportBracketResult optimistically patch local state so back-to-back result reports can't silently lose a result to a stale bracket read (same pattern as the earlier editTournament fix).
• 💡 Product idea (built): hosts had no way to undo a misreported bracket match winner. Added an undo action + small icon on completed bracket cards, host-only, blocked on byes and on matches whose winner already advanced further.
• Fixed silent chat deep-link failure: notification/coach/player "Message" links that hit a missing or private profile now show "That player couldn’t be found" instead of leaving the page blank
• 💡 Idea of the day (built): “Add to Calendar” — registered players can now download an .ics for a tournament straight from the event row
• P1/P2 items checked: both still genuinely blocked on Lok-only actions (host-account login to cancel stale test event; real signed-in registration click-through). Fixed 5 P3 bugs instead: tournament_win notification missing linkTo, ExitGuard toast missing ARIA live region, bracket round labels sorting as strings not numbers, and QR/Invite Share falling through to an unwanted silent clipboard copy on cancel + copy failures with no feedback.
• Giant Slayer badge bug (fires on equal-MMR win during calibration) confirmed root cause but needs a Supabase schema migration to fix properly — logged as too risky to do blind unattended, left in Backlog with a cheaper interim option noted.
• Continued same session: fixed 3 more P3 bugs — public site mobile nav menu now closes on outside click (was Escape/link-tap only), chat search now matches @username and message text not just display name (plus a correct "no search matches" vs "no conversations yet" empty state), and match recap share image venue/date foot
